name: b2bstore-app-server
description: B2B Store app server: phone login, shop profile, orders, settings and order alerts, all stored in Shopify.

scripts.build: esbuild src/vercel.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=api/index.js --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build from src/. Do not edit."
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npx --yes vercel@latest deploy --prod --yes
